references.text: Direct narrative connection: God's revelation (Gen 31:12) is the basis for Jacob's agreement (Gen 30:32).
Continuation of the same event: Jacob's strategy (Gen 30:40) builds directly on God's revelation about the animals' mating patterns.
Contrast within the same event: God's promise regarding the speckled animals (Gen 31:12) versus Laban's attempt to remove them (Gen 30:35).
